title: 🔱 Cosmic Architecture of Sanātana Universe
description: Master blueprint for the animation project. Multi-perspective, multi-tradition unified epic connecting dots across all Puranas.

children.title: BRANCH 1 — The Unmanifest Absolute
children.description: What existed before creation. The philosophical and Vedic foundation.

children.title: Parabrahman — The Supreme Reality
children.description: Beyond attributes, beyond time. The 'That' from which everything arises.

children.title: Nasadiya Sukta (Rigveda 10.129)
children.description: Neither sat nor asat. Even devas came later. 'Who truly knows? Who can declare?'

children.title: Even devas came later — they cannot know origin
Nirguna vs Saguna Brahman
children.description: Formless absolute vs Brahman with form. Both are same truth from different perspectives.

children.title: Consciousness Before Creation
children.description: Pure awareness (Chit). No space, no time, no matter. The seed of all existence.

children.title: BRANCH 2 — Manifestation Engine
children.description: How creation works — split into Philosophical (non-theistic Sankhya) and Theistic (Puranic) layers.

children.title: ⚙️ Philosophical Layer [Ph] — Classical Sankhya
children.description: Classical Sankhya is NON-THEISTIC (Kapila Muni). Source: Sankhya Karika.

children.title: ⚠️ Classical Sankhya is NON-THEISTIC
children.description: Source: Sankhya Karika (Ishvarakrishna)

children.title: ⚙️ Theistic Layer [P] — Puranic Integration
children.description: Puranas adopt Sankhya but theisticize it. Prakriti becomes the power of Ishvara.

children.title: Prakriti becomes the power of Ishvara (God)
Trigunas — The Three Qualities
children.description: Sattva, Rajas, Tamas — the three fundamental qualities of nature.

children.title: Kala (Time) & Cyclic Cosmology
children.description: Time as a weapon of the divine. Cycles within cycles. Nothing truly destroyed — only transformed.

children.title: BRANCH 3 — Trimurti Perspectives
children.description: Parallel origins from three traditions — each declares its deity supreme. We don't pick sides.

children.title: 🔵 Vaishnava Origin Sequence
children.description: Vishnu is supreme. Source: Vishnu Purana, Bhagavata Purana.

children.title: Vishnu declared supreme in these texts
🔴 Shaiva Origin Sequence
children.description: Shiva is supreme. Source: Shiva Purana, Linga Purana.

children.title: Shiva as Maheshwara — the supreme lord
Tandava as cosmic dance of creation
🟡 Shakta Origin Sequence
children.description: Devi is supreme. Source: Devi Bhagavata Purana.

children.title: Adi Shakti as primordial cosmic energy
🟢 Multi-Perspective Integrity
children.description: Each tradition claims supremacy. We present all without declaring one final truth. Academically honest.

children.title: BRANCH 4 — Cosmic Structure
children.description: Architecture of the universe — Lokas, time cycles, and our exact cosmic position.

children.title: 14 Lokas (Planes of Existence)
children.description: 7 upper and 7 lower planes, each with purpose, beings, and rules.

children.title: 7 Upper: Bhuloka → Bhuvar → Svar → Mahar → Jana → Tapa → Satyaloka
7 Lower: Atala → Vitala → Sutala → Rasatala → Talatala → Mahatala → Patala
Time Architecture
children.description: Kalpa, Manvantara — cosmic time divisions.

children.title: Kalpa — 1 day of Brahma (4.32 billion years)
Manvantara — Era of one Manu (306.72 million years)
📍 Our EXACT Position Now
children.description: Kali Yuga → 28th Mahayuga → Vaivasvata Manvantara → Shveta Varaha Kalpa. Source: Vishnu Purana, Bhagavata Purana.

children.title: Satya Yuga — 1,728,000 years
children.description: Age of truth

children.title: Treta Yuga — 1,296,000 years
children.description: Age of ritual

children.title: Dvapara Yuga — 864,000 years
children.description: Age of doubt

children.title: Kali Yuga — 432,000 years
children.description: Age of darkness

children.title: Sapta Rishis
children.description: Seven cosmic sages across Manvantaras. Guardians of Vedic knowledge.

children.title: BRANCH 5 — Avatar Intervention Grid
children.description: Logic: Imbalance → Adharma → Avatar descent → Restoration → Residual karma.

children.title: Logic Pattern
children.description: Every avatar follows: Imbalance → Adharma rises → Avatar descends → Restoration → Residual karmic consequence.

children.title: 9th Avatar — ⚠️ Variation Exists
children.description: Buddha (Vaishnava tradition) OR Balarama (some Puranas). Not universal.

children.title: 🅱️ Balarama — Some Puranas list him instead
Kalki — 10th Avatar (Yet to come)
children.description: End of Kali Yuga.

children.title: BRANCH 6 — Sacred Geography Layer
children.description: Connecting myths to real-world places. Critical: distinguish Scriptural Core [P] from Regional Oral Expansion [R].

children.title: 📜 Scriptural Core [P]
children.description: Events directly described in Puranas with primary textual basis.

children.title: 🗣️ Regional Oral Expansion [R]
children.description: Expanded stories from local tradition. Not directly in primary Purana verses.

children.title: Surathkal head-landing = temple tradition
children.description: Not directly detailed in primary Purana verses

children.title: Why This Distinction Matters
children.description: Merging without labels invites criticism. Showing geographical myth expansion = powerful anthropology.

children.title: BRANCH 7 — Itihasa Integration
children.description: Ramayana (Treta Yuga) + Mahabharata (Dvapara Yuga) timeline integration. Kali Yuga starts 3102 BCE.

children.title: Ramayana Timeline
children.description: Treta Yuga events. Source: Valmiki Ramayana.

children.title: Dharma vs Adharma in human form
Mahabharata Timeline
children.description: Dvapara Yuga events. Source: Vyasa Mahabharata.

children.title: Timeline Integration
children.description: How Ramayana events ripple into Mahabharata. Kali Yuga begins 3102 BCE.

children.title: BRANCH 8 — Present Era Mapping
children.description: Kali Yuga = Now. Keep THEMATIC, not sensational. No 'Puranas predicted X' claims.

children.title: Kali Yuga Characteristics — Thematic Only
children.description: Decline of dharma, rise of greed. Present as symbolic pattern recognition, NOT prophecy.

children.title: Sacred Sites Still Active
children.description: Temples still standing. Living traditions continuing. Cultural continuity across millennia.

children.title: The 'Why' Factor — Our Core Mission
children.description: People know WHAT happened. We explain WHY. This is what makes our project unique.

children.title: BRANCH 9 — Future Cosmology
children.description: Kalki, Pralaya, Brahma's lifespan, cosmic reset. Mathematics verified correct.

children.title: Kalki Avatar
children.description: Final avatar. Arrives end of Kali Yuga. Source: Kalki Purana, Bhagavata Purana.

children.title: Brahma's Lifespan
children.description: 100 Brahma years = 311.04 trillion human years. Current: 51st year.

children.title: The Cycle Restarts
children.description: New Brahma, new universe. Same eternal truths, new forms. Infinite cycles.

children.title: BRANCH 10 — 🔐 Source Validation Layer
children.description: Protects project intellectually. Tags: [S] Shruti, [P] Purana, [I] Itihasa, [Ph] Philosophy, [R] Regional.

children.title: Validation Rules
children.description: Never mix Darshana and Purana as same authority. Always tag regional traditions separately. Show variation where traditions differ.

children.title: BRANCH 11 — Dharma & Karma Framework
children.description: The 'WHY' engine of the universe. Why do cycles turn? Why do avatars descend? Why does Adharma rise? Without this branch, cosmology explains 'what' and 'when' but not 'why'.

children.title: Ṛta — Vedic Cosmic Order
children.description: The foundational concept predating Dharma. Ṛta is the cosmic principle of natural order that regulates the universe — seasons turn, rivers flow, stars move. Source: Rigveda (especially Varuna hymns).

children.title: Ṛta as cosmic law governing natural phenomena
children.description: Seasons, celestial movements, dawn and night — all follow Ṛta

children.title: Varuna as guardian of Ṛta
children.description: Rigvedic Varuna punishes violators of cosmic order. Source: Rigveda 7.86

children.title: Ṛta → Dharma transition in post-Vedic thought
children.description: Over time, Ṛta (impersonal cosmic law) evolves into Dharma (moral + social + spiritual law)

children.title: Dharma — Five Dimensions
children.description: Dharma is not a single concept. It operates simultaneously as cosmic order, moral law, natural law, social law, and spiritual alignment.

children.title: Cosmic Order (Ṛta-Dharma)
children.description: The universe self-regulates. When cosmic Dharma is violated, the system triggers correction (avatar, pralaya).

children.title: Moral Law (Sādhāraṇa Dharma)
children.description: Universal ethics — truth (satya), non-violence (ahimsa), compassion (dayā). Source: Manusmriti, Mahabharata Shanti Parva.

children.title: Natural Law (Svabhāva Dharma)
children.description: Fire burns, water flows — each element follows its intrinsic nature. This extends to all beings.

children.title: Social Law (Varṇāshrama Dharma)
children.description: ⚠️ Contextual: Originally described as duty-based, not birth-based in early texts. Bhagavad Gita 4.13: 'Chatur-varnyam maya srishtam guna-karma-vibhagashah'. Highly debated across traditions.

children.title: Spiritual Alignment (Moksha Dharma)
children.description: Ultimate Dharma = alignment with Brahman. Liberation as the final purpose. Source: Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita Ch. 18.

children.title: Dharma Evolution Across Yugas
children.description: Dharma does not remain constant. It progressively declines through the four ages — this is the engine that drives Yuga cycles.

children.title: Satya Yuga — Dharma stands on 4 legs (100%)
children.description: Truth, austerity, compassion, cleanliness all fully present. No need for scripture — people naturally aligned.

children.title: Treta Yuga — Dharma stands on 3 legs (75%)
children.description: One quarter lost. Rituals become necessary to maintain order. Source: Vishnu Purana 6.1.

children.title: Dvapara Yuga — Dharma stands on 2 legs (50%)
children.description: Half lost. Confusion rises. Even righteous people struggle with moral clarity.

children.title: Kali Yuga — Dharma stands on 1 leg (25%)
children.description: Almost entirely lost. Adharma dominant. Source: Bhagavata Purana 12.2, Vishnu Purana 6.1.

children.title: Karma — Law of Cosmic Causation
children.description: Every action has consequence. Karma operates at individual, collective, and cosmic levels. This is not 'reward/punishment' but natural law of cause-effect.

children.title: Sanchita Karma — Accumulated total
children.description: Entire storehouse of karma from all past lives. Cannot be experienced all at once.

children.title: Prarabdha Karma — Currently active portion
children.description: The portion of Sanchita selected for this life. Even avatars operate within it (Rama's exile, Krishna's departure).

children.title: Kriyamana Karma — Being created now
children.description: Actions in present life generating future consequences. This is where free will operates.

children.title: Collective Karma (Samashti Karma)
children.description: Karma of societies, civilizations, even cosmic eras. Drives Yuga transitions. Source: Mahabharata Shanti Parva.

children.title: Free Will vs Destiny (Purushartha vs Daiva)
children.description: ⚠️ One of the deepest unresolved tensions in Sanātana thought. Multiple schools offer different answers.

children.title: Advaita View — Free will is maya; only Brahman acts
children.description: Individual agency is illusion. Source: Shankara's Vivekachudamani.

children.title: Vishishtadvaita View — God enables, soul chooses
children.description: Qualified non-dualism. Source: Ramanuja's Sri Bhashya.

children.title: Dvaita View — Souls have genuine free will under God's will
children.description: Full dualism. Source: Madhva's Tattvavada.

children.title: Gita Synthesis — 'You have the right to action, not to fruits'
children.description: Bhagavad Gita 2.47: Karmanye vadhikaraste. The practical resolution offered by Krishna.

children.title: Why Adharma Inevitably Rises in Cycles
children.description: The structural explanation for why the universe cannot remain in permanent harmony. This completes the 'WHY' of avatar interventions.

children.title: Entropy of Dharma — Natural decline over time
children.description: Like heat dissipation, Dharma weakens through each Yuga. Not a moral failure — a cosmic pattern.

children.title: Adharma as Shadow of Free Will
children.description: Critical nuance: Entropy weakens Sattva, but Adharma arises when Free Will chooses wrongly within that weakened state. Preserves moral agency.

children.title: Accumulation of collective Adharma
children.description: Individual adharmic acts compound into civilizational-scale imbalance (Samashti Adharma).

children.title: Threshold trigger → Avatar descent
children.description: Bhagavad Gita 4.7: 'Yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati' — whenever Dharma declines, I manifest. This connects Branch 11 → Branch 5.

children.title: Restoration is temporary — Cycle continues
children.description: Avatar restores balance, but entropy resumes. This drives the infinite cycle (connecting to Branch 9 — Pralaya & restart).

children.title: Cross-Branch Connections
children.description: Dharma & Karma framework connects to every other branch — it is the operating logic of the entire cosmology.

children.title: → Branch 2: Trigunas determine individual dharmic capacity
→ Branch 4: Yuga cycle driven by Dharma decline
→ Branch 5: Avatar logic = Dharma restoration mechanism
→ Branch 9: Pralaya triggered when Dharma fully exhausted
